name: cases
prompt: A square image, 1024x1024, containing one circular disc. The disc is centred and its edge touches the top, bottom, left and right edges of the square; the four corners outside the circle are pure flat white. The disc itself is pure near-black #0B0E13, completely flat and unlit. Glowing on that black, like a neon sign in a dark room: one thin bright cyan #47AECB ring just inside the disc's edge, and centred within it a file folio — a plain rectangle with a raised tab at its top-left corner and one narrower card above its top edge, occupying about 44% of the disc's diameter. Both the ring and the folio are drawn as luminous bright cyan #6FD8F0 lines with a strong soft cyan bloom radiating outward into the surrounding black, and a hotter near-white cyan core along the centre of each stroke, exactly like glass neon tubing. Everything that is not the glowing cyan stays pure black. High contrast, electric, vivid. No gold, no brass, no yellow, no cream, no beige anywhere. Must stay legible at 150 pixels. No text, no letters, no numbers, no wordmark, no logo of any existing company.
